observations.observation: Query requested entity home but retrieved work=Paris first, returning Paris instead of expected home=Berlin because entity filtering was disabled.
As-of 2026-01-05 query returned Paris (future record) instead of Berlin; time-aware filtering was disabled.
As-of 2026-01-05 query returned future Paris instead of Berlin.
As-of 2026-01-09 query returned Paris instead of Berlin, showing stale/future records can outrank the valid historical record.
Entity primary query returned project-6=Bath instead of primary=Berlin, demonstrating cross-entity retrieval distraction.

hypothesis: Enabling entity and temporal pre-filters will prevent cross-entity distractors and exclude records outside the requested as-of interval, improving complete-scenario task success and reducing stale or distracting retrieval without changing writes or hard-constraint behavior.
predicted_effect: Entity-grounding and distractor cases should return the requested subject; historical-address, future-move, and history-boundary cases should select the valid as-of record. Relevant-memory recall and stale-fact rate should improve, with no expected impact on owner isolation, deletion semantics, or write precision.
